follow-up time: Until return of normal menstruation and HCG levels
outcome: Return of HCG levels to normal
cohort: 34 patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders treated with high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) followed by hysteroscopic resection.
finding: HIFU treatment followed by hysteroscopic resection is safe and effective for both placenta accreta and placenta increta, with no significant differences in treatment outcomes observed between the two groups.
